turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm in charge of the office snack order now. Thirty people, everybody has opinions.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Brave of you. Do you want to keep it mostly healthy, or just give people the crisps and chocolate they actually eat?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait for me, I need to talk to Omar about something. Don't say a word until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Omar, how many chairs did you manage to borrow?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Eleven. Mrs Patel had four, the church hall lent me the rest.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: People can stand. It's a birthday drinks, not a wedding.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grandpa can't stand for two hours, though.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then he gets the armchair. I'll put a cushion on it and a reserved sign, he'll think it's hilarious.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. And the folding table, did that come too?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's in the hallway, but one leg wobbles. Bring some tape.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done talking to them. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Your office snack order. Are we going healthy or giving the people what they want?
